summary: Design-only frontend verification of the Super Admin Live Partner Operations Command Center (/admin?tab=livemap). Authenticated programmatically via send-otp + verify-otp, injected azo_token, and ran a comprehensive Playwright test covering: page load, Google Map canvas, LIVE badge, 6 status counters, 200 partner rows of ALL statuses, drawer open/close, city filter (Patna + auto summary), category combine (Electrician), status chip filter, clear-filters, debounced search chip, all map controls (zoom/fit/fullscreen/layers overlay-menu with coverage/heatmap/traffic toggles, roadmap/satellite), legend, real-time updates every ~2.5s (counters mutated: 79->81), and dark-class propagation. All 25+ assertions passed.

issues: Minor: Google Maps JS warning in console — 'loaded directly without loading=async' and 'google.maps.Marker is deprecated, use AdvancedMarkerElement'. Not functional, but worth upgrading loader to async + migrating to AdvancedMarkerElement to future-proof.

critical_code_review_comments: LivePartnerMap.jsx is 655 lines — large but cohesive; could be split into subcomponents (StatCard/Chip/SummaryCard/ListPanel/OverlayMenu already inline) into own files for maintainability.
Google Maps loader uses legacy sync pattern — add loading=async and migrate google.maps.Marker -> AdvancedMarkerElement to avoid future breakage.

The required status cards exclude 'busy' (6 cards: available/on_job/travelling/delayed/offline/total) but 'busy' partners still count in total (observed sum=184 across 5 status cards + 16 busy = 200 total); legend shows Busy correctly. Confirm with product whether a Busy stat card is desired for parity.
seed_data_creation: None (dataset is client-side simulated in partnerSim.js)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Partner Map is fully simulated client-side. Counters mutate every 2.5s so hard-coded numeric assertions must read live DOM. Patna had 34 partners; Patna+Electrician had 4 at test time (will vary). Available-only filter returned 80. 200 partner rows render by default including all statuses (not just available). Drawer, filters, chips, overlays, map controls all functional with testids as specified.
